title: Branch preview differs from release evidence
when: Using a preview for QA or human release review
need: A branch preview changes on pushes. A release preview freezes a full candidate commit under a run-owned name; QA consumes the earlier preview receipt. Declare lifetime, data retention and cleanup ownership.
surface: Preview producer registry; the project-owned preview workflow.
gap: This distinction belongs in the short preview explanation before a URL is accepted as release evidence. Occupancy/teardown refusal must retain the frozen candidate instead of deleting it.
